charts.title: coupled-fate-oscillator — behaviour over the run
charts.srcdoc:
Coupled cell — ODE metabolism ↔ MaBoSS fate oscillator

An SBML-ODE metabolism and a MaBoSS Boolean fate network coupled both ways (mode A: metabolite C pins the fate high_C input; mode C: the fate divide output resets the metabolism). C builds, crosses threshold, fate fires, division resets the metabolism — a period-3 metabolism↔fate oscillator. Real tellurium + MaBoSS.
